FN-ITSX66W-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 215
Committee: Ports, Waterways & Intermodal Transit Sponsor: Representative Jennifer Fidler
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/05/2024
House Bill 215 as introduced could decrease potential receipts to the Department of
Conservation and Natural Resources (DCNR) and the Department of Environmental
Management (ADEM) by an undetermined amount dependent on the difference in (1) the
amount of fees collected for permits issued for the dredging of sand and source sediment to be
used for the construction of a living shoreline, and from the number of consistency
determinations issued by ADEM to certain property owners at half of the fee rates otherwise
charged and (2) the amount of fees collected under current practice. Using information from
DCNR, this bill would decrease receipts to DCNR for dredge permits by an estimated $5,200
annually, based on 2023 dredging permit data.
Page 1

FN-ITSX66W-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 215
Committee: Ports, Waterways & Intermodal Transit Sponsor: Representative Jennifer Fidler
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/06/2024
House Bill 215 as reported by the Committee on Ports, Waterways, and Intermodal Transit
could decrease potential receipts to the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources
(DCNR) by an estimated $5,200 annually, based on 2023 dredging permit data provided by
DCNR, by reducing the amount of fees collected from a residential coastal riparian owner for
permits issued for the dredging of sand and source sediment to be used for the construction of a
living shoreline.
